scope: assess github.com/enceka/cols-launcher and answer whether it is reusable for our 1649370 goal

repo.head: 1960f877b2288a306314b9887ba83fbf2a893121
repo.what_it_is: a launcher that manages a separate Rust game server (codol-server), starts the untouched native client, temporarily rewrites dwauth.ini/stun.ini/iips.ini/cacert.pem and appends a local CA, then restores everything on exit

version.evidence: profiles/codol3333.example.json is the shipped example profile; README calls the product COLS and the docs describe 3.3.3.3-era behaviour

what_it_documents_that_we_can_use.server_contract: SERVER_INTERFACE.md defines the launcher/server boundary: executable + CLI + external session records, with serve-auth, observe, create-local-player, --launcher-ready-file, and a version-1 readiness record containing PID, client SHA-256, lobby-210/game-UDP-v3, addresses, loaded map and bot room
what_it_documents_that_we_can_use.proven_flow: the repo states that on macOS/Wine it completed auth, lobby, 12-bot assembly, the Afghan map, movement, shooting, reload and match settlement; Windows and shared-human matches are not yet accepted
what_it_documents_that_we_can_use.restore_model: backup and restore of the four INI/CA files, CA appended only to the client bundle, no system trust store change, no EXE/DLL/asset modification
what_it_documents_that_we_can_use.player_model: per-player directories with random player IDs, nickname encoded into the auth ticket, level/item grants only at creation time
what_it_documents_that_we_can_use.room_bot_fill: backend.room_bot_fill 4..12, mutually exclusive with --native-bot-rooms, validated against the readiness record

what_it_does_not_give_us: no 1649370 support: the profile, the server contract and the docs are for 3.3.3.3
the game server itself is a separate repository (README refers to server/target/release/codol-server and docs/NATIVE_LAUNCHER.md in the server repo); it is not in this clone
it does not solve our in-game netchan framing: our own server1649370 still has to speak the 1649370 client's protocol

answer.reference_value: high for architecture and acceptance flow (launcher/server boundary, readiness record, temporary INI/CA restore, bot room assembly, per-player directories), and it proves this class of project can reach movement/shooting/settlement on a 3.3.3.3 client
answer.can_we_use_it_directly: not for 1649370: it targets codol3333/3.3.3.3. It is a model to copy from, not a drop-in component for our build
highest_value_next_actions: locate the sibling codol-server repository (enceka account) and read docs/NATIVE_LAUNCHER.md for the server-side acceptance contract
compare its 3.3.3.3 lobby/game-UDP framing with our 1649370 captures to isolate the generation delta
reuse the readiness-record idea as our own server's self-check endpoint
